node.title: Re^4: Generate a regex from text
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Hi [porg],

Note that in [id://1179840|that thread], [duelafn] [id://1179864|pointed out] the modules [mod://Regexp::Trie] and [mod://Regexp::Assemble], which might be helpful as well. Also, there's [mod://Regexp::Optimizer], which apparently (I haven't tried it out yet) has the ability to modify existing regexes, e.g. qr/foobar|fooxar|foozap/ becomes qr/foo(?:[bx]ar|zap)/.

Hope this helps,
-- Hauke D
